about: Front HI0: Hindi strings that may equal their English source (or hold no Devanagari letter), each with a reason (plan front-i18n-hi.md §5.4). Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.catalog:cameraPrepare.catalogEntry: a filter, a catalogue identifier and a band, all codes
entries.catalog:horizon.degrees: a value and the degree sign
entries.catalog:htl.row: a hot-list row: number, identifier and remarks joined by middle dots
entries.catalog:motion.rateOption: a rate and the multiplication sign
entries.catalog:optionsFile.source.native: a program name and its file name
entries.catalog:runningClock.coordinateValue: coordinates with the unit symbols h and °
entries.catalog:siteClock.hoursValue: a value and the unit symbol h
entries.catalog:siteClock.utValue: a value and the time-scale symbol UT
entries.map:camera.accessReason.ready: empty: the camera is ready and no reason is shown
entries.map:camera.sourceWithHash: a source label and its SHA-256 hash
entries.map:observationMetadata.row: JD, RA and Dec, the standard abbreviations (plan §12), with their values
entries.map:polish.spectrometerIndex.routes.4.la: Multi-Spec, VIREO’s own instrument name, kept as in its originals (Close Multi-Spec)
entries.original:Dec:: field label: Dec, the standard abbreviation (plan §12)
entries.original:ID #:: field label: ID # (an identifier and the number sign), as Hindi software writes ID
entries.original:PDot (S/S):: pulsar parameter symbol (period derivative, s/s), a formula symbol
entries.original:PEpoch (MJD):: pulsar parameter symbol (period epoch, MJD), a formula symbol
entries.original:RA: column label: RA, the standard abbreviation (plan §12)
entries.original:RA:: field label: RA, the standard abbreviation, kept in Latin script as Hindi astronomy texts and the catalogs write it (plan §12)
entries.original:YYYY/MM/DD: date format pattern, typed with these letters
